why: Intro to Jupyter plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-jupyter.json), 'Write notes in Markdown cells' (the notebook has a Markdown title, at least two headings and a bullet list): the bullet list is in a Markdown cell, but the learner never pressed M on the first cell. '# Step tracker', '## The data' and '## Results' sit in a code cell, where they are Python comments: it ran with no output ([1]) and shows grey code, not a title and headings. The '#' text is in the .ipynb, just not in a Markdown cell.

step.title: Add a Markdown title, headings and a list
step.instructions: At the top of steps.ipynb, add a cell, press M to make it Markdown and write a # title. Below it, add two headings and a bullet list of what the notebook does, in Markdown cells, then run them (Shift+Enter) so they render.

targets.caption: A Markdown cell with a title

step.code:

## The data

- steps for each day of one week
- a daily goal of 8000
